leadText: Yoshifumi Hagano (Japanese: Hagano Yoshifumi) is an animator. His career on Pokémon began as a Key Animator on Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon and the It'll be fine! music video, before being picked up as an Additional Character Designer on Pokémon: Hisuian Snow, where he was joined in this role by Namiko Torii under KURO.
